karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: And among all Yogîs, he who, full of faith, with the inner Self abiding in Me, adoreth Me, he is considered by Me to be the most completely harmonised.

original.text:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः

transliteration.text:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā|
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: With the mind clinging to me, O Pârtha, performing yoga, refuged in Me, how thou shalt without doubt know Me to the uttermost, that hear thou.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाच
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ|
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: The Blessed Lord

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: I will declare to thee this knowledge and wisdom in its completeness, which, having known, there is nothing more here needeth to be known.

original.text:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते

transliteration.text:
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ|
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Among thousands of men scarce one striveth for perfection; of the successful strivers scarce one knoweth Me in essence.

original.text:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्िचद्यतति सिद्धये।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्िचन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः

transliteration.text:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaśicadyatati siddhaye|
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaśicanmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, Mind, and Reason also and Egoism —these are the eightfold division of My nature.

original.text:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा

transliteration.text:
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca|
ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: This the inferior. Know My other nature, the higher, the life-element, O mighty-armed, by which the universe is upheld.

original.text:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्

transliteration.text:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām|
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Know this to be the womb of all beings. I am the source of the forthgoing of the whole universe and likewise the place of its dissolving.

original.text:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा

transliteration.text:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya|
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: There is naught whatsoever higher than I, O Dhananjaya. All this is threaded on Me, as rows of pearls on a string.

original.text:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव

transliteration.text:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya|
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: I the sapidity in waters, O son of Kuntî, I the radiance in moon and sun; the Word of Power in all the Vedas, sound in ether, and virility in men;

original.text:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु

transliteration.text:
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ|
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: The pure fragrance of earths and the bril liance in fire am I; the life in all beings am I, and the austerity in ascetics.

original.text:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु

transliteration.text:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau|
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Know Me, O Pârtha! as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the Reason of the Reason -endowed, the splendour of splendid things am I.

original.text:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्

transliteration.text:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam|
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: And I the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion. In beings I am desire not contrary to duty, O Lord of the Bharatas.

original.text:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ

transliteration.text:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam|
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: The natures that are harmonious, active, slothful, these know as from Me; not I in them, but they in me.

original.text:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि

transliteration.text:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye|
matta eveti tānviddhi natvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: All this world, deluded by these natures made by the three qualities, knoweth not Me, above these, imperishable.

original.text:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्

transliteration.text:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat|
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: This divine illusion of Mine, caused by the qualities, is hard to pierce; they who come to Me, they cross over this illusion.

original.text:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते

transliteration.text:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā|
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: The evil-doing, the deluded, the vilest men, they come not to Me, they whose wisdom is destroyed by illusion, who have embraced the nature of demons.

original.text:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः

transliteration.text:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ|
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Fourfold in division are the righteous ones who worship me, O Arjuna; the suffering, the seeker for knowledge, the self-interested and the wise, O Lord of the Bhâratas.

original.text:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ

transliteration.text:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna|
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Of these the wise, constantly harmonised, worshipping the One, is the best; I am supremely dear to the wise, and he is dear to Me.

original.text:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्ितर्विशिष्यते।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः

transliteration.text:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhakitarviśiṣyate|
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Noble are all these, but I hold the wise as verily Myself; he, Self united, is fixed on Me, the highest Path.

original.text:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्

transliteration.text:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam|
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: At the close of many births the man full of wisdom cometh unto Me; "Vâsudeva is all." saith he, the Mahâtmâ, very difficult to find.

original.text:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः

transliteration.text:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate|
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: They whose wisdom hath been rent away by desires go forth to other Shining Ones, resorting to various external observances, according to their own natures.

original.text:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया

transliteration.text:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ|
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Any devotee who seeketh to worship with faith any such aspect, I verily bestow the unswerving faith of that man.

original.text:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्

transliteration.text:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati|
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: He endowed with that faith, seeketh the worship of such a one, and from him he obtaineth his desires, I verily decreeing the benefits;

original.text:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्

transliteration.text:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate|
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitān hi tān
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Finite indeed the fruit that belongeth to those who are of small intelligence. To the Shining Ones go the worshippers of the Shining Ones, but my devotees come unto Me.

original.text:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि

transliteration.text:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām|
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Those devoid of Reason think of Me, the unmanifest, as having manifestation, knowing not My supreme nature, imperishable, most excellent.

original.text:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्ितमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्

transliteration.text:
avyaktaṃ vyakitamāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ|
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: Nor am I of all discovered, enveloped in My creation-illusion. This deluded world knoweth Me not, the unborn, the imperishable.

original.text:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्

transliteration.text:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ|
mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: I know the beings that are past, that are present, that are to come, O Arjuna, but no one knoweth Me.

original.text:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन

transliteration.text:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna|
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, sprung from attraction and repulsion, O Bhârata, all beings walk this universe wholly deluded, O Parantapa.

original.text:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।
सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप

transliteration.text:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata|
sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: But those men of pure deeds, in whom sin is come to an end, they, freed from the delusive pairs of opposites, worship Me, steadfast in vows.

original.text:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः

transliteration.text:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām|
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: They who, refuged in Me, strive for liberation from birth and death, they know the Eternal, the whole Self -knowledge, and all action.

original.text:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्

transliteration.text:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye|
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 7: The Yoga Of Discriminative Knowledge

translation.text: They who know Me as the knowledge of the elements, as that of the Shining Ones, and as that of the Sacrifice, they harmonised in mind, know Me verily even in the time of forthgoing.

original.text:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः

transliteration.text:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ|
prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Arjuna said: What is that Eternal, what Self -knowledge, what Action, O Purushottama? And what is declared to be the knowledge of the Elements, what is called the knowledge of the Shining Ones?

original.text:
अर्जुन उवाच
किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते

transliteration.text:
arjuna uvāca
kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama|
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: Arjuna

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: What is the knowledge of Sacrifice in this body, and how, O, Madhusûdana? And how, at the time of forthgoing art Thou known by the Self -controlled?

original.text:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः

transliteration.text:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana|
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: The indestructible, the supreme is the Eternal; His essential nature is called Self -knowledge; the emanation that causes the birth of beings is named Action;

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाच

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Knowledge of the Elements concerns My perishable nature, and knowledge of the Shining Ones concerns the life-giving energy; the knowledge of Sacrifice tells of Me, as wearing the body, O best of living beings.

original.text:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: And he who, casting off the body, goeth forth thinking upon Me only at the time of the end, he entereth into My being: there is no doubt of that.

original.text:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः

transliteration.text:

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Whosoever at the end abandoneth the body, thinking upon any being, to that being only he goeth, O Kaunteya, ever to that conformed in nature.

original.text:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः

transliteration.text:

taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Therefore at all times think upon Me only and fight. With mind and Reason set on Me, without doubt thou shalt come to Me.

original.text:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्

transliteration.text:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca|
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: With the mind not wandering after aught else, harmonised by continual practice, constantly meditating, O Pârtha, one goeth to the Spirit supreme, divine.

original.text:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्

transliteration.text:
abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā|
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: He who thinketh upon the Ancient, the Omniscient, the All-Ruler, minuter than the minute, the supporter of all, of form unimaginable, refulgent as the sun beyond the darkness,

original.text:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार
मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्

transliteration.text:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāra
maṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ|
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpa
mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: In the time of forthgoing, with unshaken mind, fixed in devotion, by the power of yoga drawing together his life-breath in the centre of the two eyebrows, he goeth to this Spirit, supreme, divine.

original.text:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्

transliteration.text:
prayāṇakāle manasā'calena
bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva|
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak
sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: That which is declared indestructible by the Veda-knowers, that which the controlled and passion-free enter, that desiring which Brahmacharya is performed, that path I will declare to thee with brevity.

original.text:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये

transliteration.text:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti
viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ|
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti
tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: All the gates closed, the mind confined in the heart, the life-breath fixed in his own head, concentrated by yoga,

original.text:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्

transliteration.text:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca|
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: "Aum!" the one syllabled Eternal, reciting, thinking upon Me, he who goeth forth, abandoning the body, he goeth on the highest path.

original.text:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्

transliteration.text:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran|
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: He who constantly thinketh upon Me, not thinking ever of another, of him I am easily reached, O Pârtha, of this ever-harmonised Yogî.

original.text:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः

transliteration.text:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ|
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Having come to Me, these Mahâtmâs come not again to birth, the place of pain, non-eternal; they have gone to the highest bliss.

original.text:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः

transliteration.text:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam|
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: The worlds, beginning with the world of Brahmâ, they come and go, O Arjuna; but he who cometh unto Me, O Kaunteya, he knoweth birth no more.

original.text:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते

transliteration.text:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino'rjuna|
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: The people who know the day of Brahmâ, a thousand ages in duration, and the night a thousand ages in ending, they know day and night.

original.text:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः

transliteration.text:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ|
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: From the unmanifested all the manifested stream forth at the coming of day; at the coming of night they dissolve, even in That called the unmanifested.

original.text:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके

transliteration.text:
avyaktādvyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame|
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: This multitude of beings, going forth repeatedly, is dissolved at the coming of night: by ordination, O Pârtha, it streams forth at the coming of day.

original.text:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे

transliteration.text:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate|
rātryāgame'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Therefore verily there existeth, higher than that unmanifested, another unmanifested, eternal, which in the destroying of all beings, is not destroyed.

original.text:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति

transliteration.text:

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: That unmanifested, "the Indestructible," It is called; It is named the highest Path. They who reach It return not. That is My supreme abode.

original.text:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम

transliteration.text:

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: He, the highest Spirit, O Pârtha, may be reached by unswerving devotion to Him alone, in whom all beings abide, by whom all This is pervaded.

original.text:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्

transliteration.text:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā|
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: That time wherein going forth Yogîs return not, and also that wherein going forth they return, that time shall I declare to thee, O prince of the Bhâratas.

original.text:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ

transliteration.text:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ|
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Fire, light, day-time, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path —then, going forth, the men who know the Eternal go to the Eternal.

original.text:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः

transliteration.text:
agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam|
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Smoke, night-time, the dark fortnight also, the six months of the southern path —then the Yogî, obtaining the moonlight, returneth.

original.text:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते

transliteration.text:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam|
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Light and darkness, these are thought to be the world's everlasting paths; by the one he goeth who returneth not, by the other he who returneth again.

original.text:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः

transliteration.text:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate|
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayā''vartate punaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: Knowing these paths, O Pârtha, the Yogi is nowise perplexed. Therefore in all times be firm in yoga, O Arjuna.

original.text:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन

transliteration.text:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana|
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 8: The Yoga Of The Indesctructible Supreme Eternal

translation.text: The fruit of meritorious deeds, attached in the Vedas to sacrifices, to austerities, and also to almsgiving, the Yogî passeth all these by having known this, and goeth to the supreme and ancient Seat.

original.text:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्

transliteration.text:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva
dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam|
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā
yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: To thee, the uncarping, verily shall I declare this profoundest Secret, wisdom with knowledge combined, which, having known, thou shalt be freed from evil.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाच
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave|
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: The Blessed Lord

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: Kingly Science, kingly Secret, supreme Purifier, this; intuitional, according to righteousness, very easy to perform, imperishable.

original.text:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्

transliteration.text:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam|
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: Men without faith in this knowledge, O Parantapa, not reaching Me, return to the paths of this world of death.

original.text:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि

transliteration.text:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa|
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: By Me all this world is pervaded in My unmanifested aspect; all beings have root in Me, I am not rooted in them.

original.text:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः

transliteration.text:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā|
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: Nor have beings root in Me; behold My sovereign Yoga! The support of beings, yet not rooted in beings, My Self their efficient cause.

original.text:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः

transliteration.text:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram|
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: As the mighty air everywhere moving is rooted in the Ether, so all beings rest rooted in Me—thus know thou.

original.text:
यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय

transliteration.text:
yathā''kāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān|
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: All beings, O Kaunteya, enter my lower nature at the end of a world-age; at the beginning of a world-age again I emanate them.

original.text:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: The knowers of the three, the Soma-drinkers, the purified from sin, worshipping Me with sacrifice, pray of Me the way to heaven; they, ascending to the holy world of the Ruler of the Shining Ones, eat in heaven the divine feasts of the Shining Ones.

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

section: Chapter 9: The Yoga Of The Kingly Science And The Kingly Secret

translation.text: The seven great Rishis, the ancient Four, and also the Manus, were born of My nature, and mind; of them this race was generated.

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: I, O Gudakesha, am the Self, seated in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and also the end of all beings.

translation.text: Of the Adityas I am Vishnu; of radiances the glorious sun; I am Marîchi of the Maruts; of the asterisms the Moon am I.

translation.text: And all-devouring Death am I, and the origin of all to come; and of feminine qualities, fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, constancy, forgiveness.

translation.text: Of hymns also Brihatsâman; Gâyatrî of metres am I; of months I am Mârgasîrsha; of seasons the flowery.

translation.text: And whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that am I, O Arjuna; nor is there aught, moving or unmoving, that may exist bereft of Me.

translation.text: There is no end of My divine powers, O Parantapa. What has been declared is illustrative of My infinite glory.

translation.text: Whatsoever is glorious, good, beautiful, and mighty, understand thou that to go forth from a fragment of My splendour.

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Here, to-day, behold the whole universe, movable and immovable, standing in one in My body, O Gudâkesha, with aught else thou desirest to see.

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: But verily thou art not able to behold Me with these thine eyes; the divine eye I give unto thee. Behold My sovereign Yoga.

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Wearing divine necklaces and vestures, anointed with divine unguents, the God all-marvellous, boundless, with face turned everywhere.

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: There Pândava beheld the whole universe, divided into manifold parts, standing in one in the body of the Deity of Deities.

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: With mouths, eyes, arms, breasts multitudinous, I see Thee everywhere, unbounded Form. Beginning, middle, end, nor source of Thee, Infinite Lord, infinite Form, I find;

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Radiant, Thou touchest heaven, rainbow-hued, With opened mouths and shining vast-orbed eyes. My inmost self is quaking, having seen, My strength is withered, Vishnu, and my peace.

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Like Time's destroying flames I see Thy teeth, Upstanding, spread within expanded jaws; Nought know I anywhere, no shelter find; Mercy, O God! re of all the worlds!

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: As river-floods impetuously rush, Hurling their waters into ocean's lap, So fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths, In haste, these mighty men, these lords of earth.

विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति

samudramevābhimukhāḥ dravanti|
tathā tavāmī naralokavīrā
viśanti vaktrāṇyabhivijvalanti
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: As moths with quickened speed will headlong fly Into a flaming light, to fall destroyed, So also these, in haste precipitate, Enter within Thy mouths destroyed to fall.

original.text:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका
स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः

transliteration.text:
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā
viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ|
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokā
stavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: On every side, all-swallowing, fiery-tongued, Thou lickest up mankind, devouring all; The glory filleth space: the universe Is burning, Vishnu, with Thy blazing rays.

original.text:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता
ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो

transliteration.text:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantā
llokānsamagrānvadanairjvaladbhiḥ|
tejobhirāpūrya jagatsamagraṃ
bhāsastavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Reveal Thy Self; what awful Form art Thou? I worship Thee! Have mercy, God supreme! Thine inner Being I am fain to know; This Thy forth-streaming Life bewilders me.

original.text:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्

transliteration.text:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo
namo'stu te devavara prasīda|
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ
na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Time am I, laying desolate the world, Made manifest on earth to slay mankind! Not one of all these warriors ranged for strife Escapeth death; thou shalt alone survive.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाच
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
kālo'smi lokakṣayakṛtpravṛddho
lokānsamāhartumiha pravṛttaḥ|
ṛte'pi tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve
ye'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Therefore stand up! win for thyself renown, Conquer thy foes, enjoy the wealth filled realm, By Me they are already overcome, Be thou the outward cause, left-handed one.

original.text:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्

transliteration.text:
tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva
jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham|
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva
nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Drona and Bhîshma and Jayadratha, Karna, and all the other warriors here, Are slain by Me. Destroy them fearlessly. Fight! thou shalt crush thy rivals in the field.

original.text:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्

transliteration.text:
droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca
karṇaṃ tathā'nyānapi yodhavīrān|
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi mā vyathiṣṭhā
yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Sanjaya said: Having heard these words of Keshava, he who weareth a diadem, with joined palms, quaking and prostrating himself, spake again to Krishna, stammering with fear, casting down his face.

original.text:
सञ्जय उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य

transliteration.text:
sañjaya uvāca
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya
kṛtāñjalirvepamānaḥ kirīṭī|
namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ
sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: Sanjaya

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Arjuna said: Hrishîkesha! in Thy magnificence Rightly the world rejoiceth, hymning Thee; The Râkshasas to every quarter fly In fear; the hosts of Siddhas prostrate fall.

original.text:
अर्जुन उवाच
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः

transliteration.text:
arjuna uvāca
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā
jagat prahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca|
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti
sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: Arjuna

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: How should they otherwise, O loftiest Self! First Cause! Brahmâ Himself less great than Thou. Infinite, God of Gods, home of all worlds, Unperishing, Sat, Asat, That supreme!

original.text:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्

transliteration.text:
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman
garīyase brahmaṇo'pyādikartre|
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa
tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: First of the Gods, most ancient Man Thou art. Supreme receptacle of all that lives; Knower and known, the dwelling-place on high; In Thy vast Form the universe is spread.

original.text:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण
स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप

transliteration.text:
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇa
stvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam|
vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma
tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Thou art Vâyu and Yama, Agni, moon, Varuna, Father, Grandsire of all; Hail, hail to Thee! a thousand times all hail! Hail unto Thee! again, again all hail!

original.text:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते

transliteration.text:
vāyuryamo'gnirvaruṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ
prajāpatistvaṃ prapitāmahaśca|
namo namaste'stu sahasrakṛtvaḥ
punaśca bhūyo'pi namo namaste
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Prostrate in front of Thee, prostrate behind; Prostrate on every side to Thee, O All. In power boundless, measureless in strength, Thou holdest all: then Thou Thyself art All.

original.text:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः

transliteration.text:
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste
namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva|
anantavīryāmitavikramastvaṃ
sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato'si sarvaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: If, thinking Thee but friend, importunate, O Krishna! or O Yâdava! O friend! I cried, unknowing of Thy majesty, And careless in the fondness of my love;

original.text:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि

transliteration.text:
sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ
he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti|
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ
mayā pramādātpraṇayena vāpi
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: If jesting I irreverence showed to Thee, At play, reposing, sitting or at meals, Alone, O sinless One, or with my friends, Forgive my error, O Thou boundless One.

original.text:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्

transliteration.text:
yaccāvahāsārthamasatkṛto'si
vihāraśayyāsanabhojaneṣu|
eko'thavāpyacyuta tatsamakṣaṃ
tatkṣāmaye tvāmahamaprameyam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Father of worlds, of all that moves and stands, Worthier of reverence than the Guru's self, There is none like to Thee. Who passeth Thee? Pre-eminent Thy power in all the worlds.

original.text:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव

transliteration.text:
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya
tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān|
na tvatsamo'styabhyadhikaḥ kuto'nyo
lokatraye'pyapratimaprabhāva
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Therefore I fall before Thee; with my body I worship as it fitting; bless Thou me. As father with the son, as friend with friend, With the beloved as lover, bear with me.

original.text:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्

transliteration.text:
tasmātpraṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ
prasādaye tvāmahamīśamīḍyam|
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ
priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: I have seen that which none hath seen before, My heart is glad, yet faileth me for fear; Show me, O God, Thine other Form again— Mercy, O God of Gods, home of all worlds—

original.text:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास

transliteration.text:
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā
bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me|
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ
prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Diademed, mace and discus in Thy hand. Again I fain would see Thee as before; Put on again Thy four-armed shape, O Lord, O thousand-armed, of forms innumerate.

original.text:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त
मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते

transliteration.text:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahasta
micchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva|
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena
sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: Arjuna, by My favour thou hast seen, This loftiest Form by yoga's self revealed! Radiant, all-penetrating, endless, first, That none except thyself hath ever seen.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाच
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ
rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt|
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ
yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: The Blessed Lord

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Nor sacrifice, nor Vedas, alms, nor works, Nor sharp austerity, nor study deep, Can win the vision of this Form for man, Foremost of Kurus, thou alone hast seen.

original.text:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै
र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर

transliteration.text:
na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānai
rna ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ|
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke
draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Be not bewildered, be thou not afraid, Because thou hast beheld this awful Form; Cast fear away, and let thy heart rejoice; Behold again Mine own familiar shape.

original.text:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य

transliteration.text:
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo
dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam|
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ
tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Sanjaya said: Vâsudeva, having thus spoken to Arjuna, again manifested His own Form, and consoled the terrified one, the Mahâtman again assuming a gentle form.

original.text:
सञ्जय उवाच
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा

transliteration.text:
sañjaya uvāca
ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā
svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ|
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ
bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: Sanjaya

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Arjuna said: Beholding again Thy gentle human Form, O Janârdana, I am now collected, and am restored to my own nature.

original.text:
अर्जुन उवाच
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः

transliteration.text:
arjuna uvāca
dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tavasaumyaṃ janārdana|
idānīmasmi saṃvṛttaḥ sacetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: Arjuna

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: This Form of Mine beholden by thee is very hard to see. Verily the Shining Ones ever long to behold this form.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाच
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi yanmama|
devā apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: The Blessed Lord

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: Nor can I be seen as thou hast seen Me by the Vedas, nor by austerities, nor by alms, or by offerings;

original.text:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा

transliteration.text:
nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā|
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: But by devotion to Me alone I may thus be perceived, Arjuna, and known and seen in essence, and entered, O Parantapa.

original.text:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।
ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप

transliteration.text:
bhaktyā tvananyayā śakyamahamevaṃvidho'rjuna|
jñātuṃ dṛṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 11: The Yoga Of The Vision Of The Universal Form

translation.text: He who doeth actions for Me, whose supreme good I am, My devotee, freed from attachment without hatred of any being, he cometh unto Me, O Pândava.

original.text:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव

transliteration.text:
matkarmakṛnmatparamo madbhaktaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ|
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Arjuna said: Those devotees who ever harmonised worship Thee, and those also who worship the Indestructible, the Unmanifested, whether of these is the more learned in yoga?

original.text:
अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।
येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः

transliteration.text:
arjuna uvācaevaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktāstvāṃ paryupāsate|
yecāpyakṣaramavyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: They who with mind fixed on Me ever harmonised worship Me, with faith supreme endowed, these, in My opinion, are best in yoga.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।
श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvācamayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate|
śraddhayā parayopetāste me yuktatamā matāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: They who worship the Indestructible, the Ineffable, the unmanifested, Omnipresent, and Unthinkable, the Unchanging, Immutable, Eternal,

original.text:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।
सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्

transliteration.text:
ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyamavyaktaṃ paryupāsate|
sarvatragamacintyaṃ ca kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Restraining and subduing the senses, regarding everything equally, in the welfare of all rejoicing, these also come unto Me.

original.text:
संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः

transliteration.text:
saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ|
te prāpnuvanti māmeva sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: The difficulty of those whose minds are set on the Unmanifested is greater; for the path of the Unmanifested is hard for the embodied to reach.

original.text:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते

transliteration.text:
kleśo'dhikatarasteṣāmavyaktāsaktacetasām|
avyaktā hi gatirduḥkhaṃ dehavadbhiravāpyate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Those verily who, renouncing all actions in Me and intent on Me, worship meditating on Me, with whole-hearted yoga,

original.text:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते

transliteration.text:
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥ|
ananyenaiva yogena māṃ dhyāyanta upāsate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: These I speedily lift up from the ocean of death and existence, O Pârtha, their minds being fixed on Me.

original.text:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।
भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्

transliteration.text:
teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt|
bhavāmi nacirātpārtha mayyāveśitacetasām
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Place thy mind in me, into Me let thy Reason enter; then without doubt thou shalt abide in Me hereafter.

original.text:
मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः

transliteration.text:
mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya|
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: And if thou art not able firmly to fix thy mind on Me, then by the yoga of practice seek to reach Me, O Dhananjaya.

original.text:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।
अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय

transliteration.text:
atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram|
abhyāsayogena tato māmicchāptuṃ dhanañjaya
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: If also thou art not equal to constant practice, be intent on My service; performing actions for My sake, thou shalt attain perfection.

original.text:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि

transliteration.text:
abhyāse'pyasamartho'si matkarmaparamo bhava|
madarthamapi karmāṇi kurvan siddhimavāpsyasi
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: If even to do this thou hast not strength, then, taking refuge in union with Me, renounce all fruit of action with the self controlled.

original.text:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्

transliteration.text:
athaitadapyaśakto'si kartuṃ madyogamāśritaḥ|
sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Better indeed is wisdom than constant-practice; than wisdom, meditation is better; than meditation, renunciation of the fruit of action; on renunciation follows peace.

original.text:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।
ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्

transliteration.text:
śreyo hi jñānamabhyāsājjñānāddhyānaṃ viśiṣyate|
dhyānātkarmaphalatyāgastyāgācchāntiranantaram
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: He who beareth no ill-will to any being, friendly and compassionate, without attachment and egoism, balanced in pleasure and pain, and forgiving,

original.text:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी

transliteration.text:
adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca|
nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Ever content, harmonious, with the self-controlled, resolute, with mind and Reason dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

original.text:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः

transliteration.text:
santuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ|
mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: He from whom the world doth not shrink away, who doth not shrink away from the world, freed from the anxieties of joy, anger, and fear, he is dear to me.

original.text:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः

transliteration.text:
yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥ|
harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: He who wants nothing, is pure, expert, passionless, untroubled, renouncing every undertaking, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

original.text:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः

transliteration.text:
anapekṣaḥ śucirdakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥ|
sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: He who neither loveth nor hateth, nor grieveth, nor desireth, renouncing good and evil, full of devotion, he is dear to Me.

original.text:
यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः

transliteration.text:
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati|
śubhāśubhaparityāgī bhakitamānyaḥ sa me priyaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Alike to foe and friend, and also in fame and ignominy, alike in cold and heat, pleasures and pains, destitute of attachment,

original.text:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः

transliteration.text:
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ|
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: Taking equally praise and reproach, silent, wholly content with what cometh, homeless, firm in mind, full of devotion, that man is dear to Me.

original.text:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः

transliteration.text:
tulyanindāstutirmaunī santuṣṭo yenakenacit|
aniketaḥ sthiramatirbhakitamānme priyo naraḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

translation.text: They verily who partake of this life-giving wisdom as taught herein, endued with faith, I their supreme Object, devotees, they are surpassingly dear to Me.

original.text:
ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः

transliteration.text:
ye tu dharmyāmṛtamidaṃ yathoktaṃ paryupāsate|
śraddadhānā matparamā bhaktāste'tīva me priyāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Arjuna said: Matter and Spirit, even the Field and the Knower of the Field, wisdom and that which ought to be known, these I fain would learn, O Keshava.

original.text:
अर्जुन उवाच
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च।
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव

transliteration.text:
arjuna uvāca
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca|
etadveditumicchāmi jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ ca keśava
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: Arjuna

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: This body, son of Kuntî, is called the Field; that which knoweth it is called the Knower of the Field by the Sages.

original.text:
श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः

transliteration.text:
śrī bhagavānuvācaidaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetramityabhidhīyate|
etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: The Blessed Lord

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Understand Me as the Knower of the Field in all Fields, O Bhârata. Wisdom as to the Field and the Knower of the Field, that in My opinion is the wisdom.

original.text:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम

transliteration.text:
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata|
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: What that Field is and of what nature, how modified, and whence it is, and what He is and what His powers, hear that now briefly from Me.

original.text:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु

transliteration.text:
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛk ca yadvikāri yataśca yat|
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śrṛṇu
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Rishis have sung in manifold ways, in many various chants, and in decisive Brahma-sûtra verses full of reasonings.

original.text:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।
ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः

transliteration.text:
ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītaṃ chandobhirvividhaiḥ pṛthak|
brahmasūtrapadaiścaiva hetumadbhirviniśicataiḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: The great Elements, Individuality, Reason, and also the unmanifested, the ten senses and the one, and the five pastures of the senses;

original.text:
महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः

transliteration.text:
mahābhūtānyahaṅkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca|
indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, combination, intelligence, firmness; these, briefly described, constitute the Field and its modifications.

original.text:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्

transliteration.text:
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanādhṛtiḥ|
etatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Humility, unpretentiousness, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service of the teacher, purity, steadfastness, self-control.

original.text:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः

transliteration.text:
amānitvamadambhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam|
ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Dispassion towards the objects of the senses, and also absence of egoism, insight into the pain and evil of birth, death, old age and sickness,

original.text:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्

transliteration.text:
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṅkāra eva ca|
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Unattachment, absence of self-identification with son, wife or home, and constant balance of mind in wished-for and unwished-for events,

original.text:
असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु

transliteration.text:
asakitaranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu|
nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Unflinching devotion to Me by yoga, without other objects, resort to sequestered places, absence of enjoyment in the company of men,

original.text:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि

transliteration.text:
mayi cānanyayogena bhakitaravyabhicāriṇī|
viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Constancy in the wisdom of the Self, understanding of the object of essential wisdom; that is declared to be the Wisdom; all against it is ignorance.

original.text:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा

transliteration.text:
adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam|
etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadatonyathā
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: I will declare that which ought to be known, that which being known immortality is enjoyed—the beginningless supreme Eternal, called neither being nor non-being.

original.text:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते

transliteration.text:
jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā'mṛtamaśnute|
anādimatparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate
transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 13: The Yoga Of The Distinction Between The Field And The Knower Of The Field

translation.text: Everywhere That hath hands and feet, everywhere eyes, heads, and mouths; all-hearing, He dwelleth in the world, enveloping all,

original.text:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

translation.text: When the dweller in the body hath crossed over these three qualities, whence all bodies have been produced, liberated from birth, death, old age and sorrow, he drinketh the nectar of immortality.

original.text:

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

translation.text: The Blessed Lord said: He, O Pândava, who hateth not radiance, nor outgoing energy, nor even delusion, when present, nor longeth after them, absent;

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

speaker: The Blessed Lord

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

translation.text: He who, seated as a neutral, is unshaken by the qualities; who, saying, "The qualities revolve," standeth apart immovable.

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

translation.text: Balanced in pleasure and pain, self-reliant, to whom a lump of earth, a rock and gold are alike, the same to loved and unloved, firm, the same in censure and in praise,

original.text:

तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

translation.text: The same in honour and ignominy, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings—he is said to have crossed over the qualities.

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

translation.text: And he who serveth Me exclusively by the Yoga of devotion, he, crossing beyond the qualities, he is fit to become the Eternal.

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 14: The Yoga Of Separation From The Three Qualities

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: A portion of Mine own Self, transformed in the world of life into an immortal Spirit, draweth round itself the senses of which the mind is the sixth, veiled in matter.

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: Yogîs also, struggling, perceive Him, established in the Self; but though struggling, the unintelligent perceive Him not, their selves untrained.

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: That splendour issuing from the sun that enlighteneth the whole world, that which is in the moon and in fire, that splendour know as from Me.

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: Permeating the soil, I support beings by my vital energy, and having become the delicious Soma I nourish all plants.

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: I, having become the Fire of Life, take possession of the bodies of breathing things, and united with the life-breaths, I digest the four kinds of food.

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: And I am seated in the hearts of all, and from Me memory and wisdom and their absence. And that which is to be known in all the Vedas am I; and I indeed the Veda-knower and the author of the Vedanta.

original.text:

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

translation.text: There are two Energies in this world, the destructible and the indestructible; the destructible is all beings, the unchanging is called the indestructible.

original.text:

section: Chapter 15: The Yoga Of Attaining The Supreme Spirit

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

translation.text: "The universe is without truth, without basis," they say, "without a God; brought about by mutual union, and caused by lust and nothing else."

transliteration.method: Generated from the Devanagari with indic-transliteration (MIT)

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

translation.text: Holding this view, these ruined selves of small understanding, of fierce deeds, come forth as enemies for the destruction of the world.

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

translation.text: Surrendering themselves to insatiable desires, possessed with vanity, conceit and arrogance, holding evil ideas through delusion, they engage in action with impure resolves.

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

translation.text: Giving themselves over to unmeasured thought whose end is death, regarding the gratification of desires as the highest, feeling sure that this is all,

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

translation.text: Held in bondage by a hundred ties of expectation, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain by unlawful means hoards of wealth for sensual enjoyments.

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

section: Chapter 16: The Yoga Of Division Between The Divine And The Demoniacal

translation.text: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, enmeshed in the web of delusion, addicted to the gratification of desire, they fall downwards into a foul hell.

translation.text: Self-glorifying, stubborn, filled with the pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform lip-sacrifices for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinance.

translation.text: Given over to egoism, power, insolence, lust and wrath, these malicious ones hate Me in the bodies of others and in their own.

translation.text: Triple is the gate of this hell, destructive of the self—lust, wrath, and greed; therefore let man renounce these three.

translation.text: Therefore let the Scriptures be thy authority, in determining what ought to be done, or what ought not to be done. Knowing what hath been declared by the ordinances of the Scriptures, thou oughtest to work in this world.

section: Chapter 17: The Yoga Of The Division Of Threefold Faith

section: Chapter 17: The Yoga Of The Division Of Threefold Faith

translation.text: The men who perform severe austerities, unenjoined by the Scriptures, wedded to vanity and egoism, impelled by the force of their desires and passions,

translation.text: Unintelligent, tormenting the aggregated elements forming the body, and Me also, seated in the inner body, know these demoniacal in their resolves.

original.text:
कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।
मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्

karṣayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmamacetasaḥ|
